title: registry-v0 record — one curated YAML file per registered repository
description: The P-M2-only, PR-curated registry source of truth: one file `repos/{node_id}.yml` in the public registry-v0 repository (FS-02 §7 FS02-060). Validated by that repository's CI on every pull request against THIS schema (FS02-061), and consumed by the index-build-lite job that renders the published artifacts (VS-04). Two hard constraints carry legal weight: (1) there is NO `waivers` field and there never will be — waivers are issued only by a claimed admin from the platform dashboard (D14), so no waiver can enter the registry by pull request; (2) the YAML file is a CACHE of display facts, while the repository's own committed LICENSE file is the truth about adoption (D13). Filename must equal `node_id`. Frozen and archived at P-M3 with a pointer to the export endpoints (FS-00 §2).

schema.description: Record schema tag. A value this validator does not know must fail the pull request — a broken registry never half-publishes (FS02-063).

node_id.description: GitHub GraphQL node_id — the primary key, and the filename. Format is validated here; existence cannot be validated at v0 (P-M2 §4.2 edge case 4).

owner.description: Owner login. DISPLAY CACHE ONLY — refreshed by the operator on a rename; never a key, never money-bearing (FS02-017).

name.description: Repository name. Display cache only. Also the shard key for the published registry index (first character, FS02-062).

state.description: The FS-02 §3 state enum verbatim. `detected` repositories appear in aggregate counts only — no listing, no badge (GH-014).

id.description: Licence identifier carried by the repository's LICENSE file (working form `PurposeSource-1.0`; final string per URS §21 OPEN-20).

version.description: Licence version, when tracked separately from the identifier. The per-version publication date anchors the fixed 4-year Apache-2.0 conversion clock (D9).

published.description: Publication date of that licence version — the conversion-clock anchor (D9).

adopted.description: Date the LICENSE commit landed on the default branch. Adoption completes on that merge and nothing else (VIS-01).

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed licence text, as evidence for the canonical-text check (GH-015). A modified text is not an adoption (D10).

weight_class.description: Pricing weight class (D11). Set through the dashboard menu, never by the manifest (APP-029); at v0 by operator-merged pull request.

inbound_family.description: Inbound-licence family recorded for the adoption gate (GH-043). Escrow candidates with copyleft inbound complete the consent path manually or do not qualify (P-M2 §5 item 12).

allocation_defaults.description: Optional category-fund default slugs; the steward default applies when absent.

repo_url.description: Convenience display link. Derivable from owner/name; recorded so a renamed repository still resolves for a human reviewer.

canonical_of.description: Set on the canonical repository of a fork family (GH-008). Forks are linked, never registered.

notes.description: Curation note for reviewers. Never rendered on a public page.
